title: Jade Sleet Linked to Indian IT Provider Breach With FLATROOF and ROOFDECK Backdoors
summary: The North Korean threat actor known as Jade Sleet has been attributed to the compromise of an India-based "much smaller organization" in the information technology (IT) services industry, once again highlighting how the adversary continues to target developers to breach target networks.
